competitors.name: Social Blade
competitors.title: YouTube Money Calculator - See How Much Money You Can Make
competitors.metaDescription: Calculate estimated YouTube video earnings and channel income with Social Blade's free YouTube Money Calculator.
weaknesses: Outdated flat CPM slider ($0.25 - $4.00), does not model modern 2026 niches like B2B SaaS, AI, or Finance ($20+ RPM)
Does not deduct YouTube's 45% platform cut (shows gross rather than true net bank take-home)
Zero tax shield calculations (no S-Corp vs LLC modeling)

competitors.name: Influencer Marketing Hub
competitors.title: YouTube Money Calculator - See How Much You Could Make
competitors.metaDescription: Calculate how much YouTube pays per view and estimate your video earnings with our free interactive YouTube money calculator.
weaknesses: Excessive ad clutter and popups harming Core Web Vitals (CLS & FID)
Does not support multi-currency real-time conversions (USD only)
Lacks Shorts vs Long-Form 15x revenue divergence modeling
